scope: Rights-attributed H3 topology-positive Ref2VA dataset compilation
summary: Six 39-frame topology-positive training clips were compiled from two articulated robot subjects with separate validation and test sources retained outside optimization.
evidence: The plan contains six train clips, one validation clip, and one subject-disjoint test clip at 448x256, 24 FPS, and 39 frames.
Every prepared training item has an explicit reference image, silent 32 kHz audio stream, topology-specific prompt, source path, license note, and source URI.
The completed training dataset manifest SHA-256 is 1118ee94b53e3dac68bf662e5ccf6a4615d1bc905b576f2dac77bcfe351159c6.
lessons: Crossed-arm and self-occlusion examples must explicitly supervise unique shoulder origins, not merely stable appearance.
limitations: Training positives are simplified procedural renders and do not establish photorealism or real flower contact.
Validation and test items are topology-only evidence and remain rejected for overall flower-manipulation quality.
